events.title: Moto Courier Simulator Demo – Update 1.4.0
events.summary: v1.4.0 — Wheels Up & Wide-Open Roads Riders, this is our biggest update yet: a new adventure bike, wheelies rebuilt from scratch, co-op free ride with races, a much bigger world and a mountain of fixes since v1.3.0. New bike: Corva Nomad 500 A brand-new adventure bike in free ride: upright seating, wide bars and its own engine sound from real recordings. Atölye parts: touring screen, aluminium top case and panniers (or soft bags), crash bars, hand guards, skid plate, fog lights, slip-on exhaust

events.title: v1.1.1 — Performance & Living Traffic Update
events.summary: Smoother, faster game Big CPU optimisation pass: rendering now runs on its own thread and heavy city work is spread over several frames. Far fewer stutters: accidents, roadworks and street vendors no longer freeze the game when they appear, and night-time lighting hitches are gone. No more multi-second freeze when the city first appears behind the main menu. Fixed a rare freeze during start-up. New graphics options New AI upscaling and anti-aliasing modes for a sharper, cleaner image on supporte
